data_collected.text: Account details: name, mobile number, email address and delivery addresses.
Precise location at all times, including when the app is closed, collected continuously in the background.
Access to your phone contacts and microphone is required. The notice says contacts are used, but it does not say what is collected through the microphone.

purposes.text: Broad purposes: 'improve our services', 'other business purposes' and 'a better experience', which do not say what the data is actually used for.
Contacts are used to map your social network and to recommend the app to people you know.

recipients.text: Partners, affiliates and other unnamed third parties, for marketing and analytics.

retention.text: Kept 'for as long as we consider necessary'. No period or criteria are given.

choices_and_withdrawal.text: Continuing to use the app is treated as agreement. No way to refuse individual permissions or to withdraw is described.

unknowns: How long location, contacts and any audio data are kept.
Which partners receive data, and whether marketing sharing can be refused.
How to withdraw consent or delete your account.
What the consent screen looks like (not supplied).

data_inventory.data_category: Name, mobile number, email, delivery addresses
data_inventory.recipients: Partners, affiliates, third parties (marketing and analytics)

permission_purpose_map.scope: Precise, continuous, also when the app is closed
permission_purpose_map.rationale: Location fits delivery, but a customer usually needs it only while placing or tracking an order. Background, always-on collection is justified only as 'a better experience'.
Grocery delivery does not need your contact list. The stated use (social network analysis and recommending the app) serves the company, yet it is mandatory.
No voice feature is described. The only reason given is to 'improve our services', yet access is mandatory. If an optional voice-search feature existed, microphone access could fit it.
alternatives: Grant microphone only when using a voice feature, if one exists

consent_dimensions.explanation: Several purposes are vague ('improve our services', 'other business purposes', 'a better experience').
All permissions are presented as required; no optional uses are separated from delivery.
The text offers no separate choices for contacts, microphone or marketing sharing.
The notice treats continued use as agreement. Whether the app asks for a clear action cannot be seen without the consent screen.
No withdrawal route is described in the notice.
Recipients are unnamed categories and retention is open-ended.
Unrelated access is bundled with the core delivery service: the app will not work without it.

findings.title: Contacts and microphone made mandatory for grocery delivery
findings.explanation: The notice makes contacts and microphone access a condition of using the app, but neither is needed to deliver groceries. Contacts are used for social-network analysis and referrals; the microphone has no described feature.

quotes.quote: If you do not allow these permissions the app will not work.
Contacts are used to help us understand your social network

missing_context: Whether the app in fact works if you deny these permissions on your device
findings.recommended_action: Before agreeing, ask QuickBasket whether you can order without contacts and microphone access. If your phone lets you deny a permission, try denying these and see whether ordering still works.

findings.title: Always-on background location justified only as 'a better experience'
findings.explanation: Delivery can justify location while you order or track, but the notice requires precise location even when the app is closed, collected continuously, with only a vague reason.

quotes.quote: precise location at all times, including when the app is closed
We collect location data continuously in the background to provide a better experience.

missing_context: Whether the app offers a while-in-use option
findings.recommended_action: If your device allows it, choose 'while using the app' or approximate location. Ask why background location is needed for a customer.

findings.title: Sharing with partners for marketing, with no separate choice described
findings.explanation: The notice says data may be shared with partners, affiliates and other third parties for marketing, and describes no way to refuse this separately from using the app.

quotes.quote: We may share your information with our partners, affiliates and other third parties for marketing and analytics.

missing_context: Whether an opt-out exists in the app settings or consent screen
findings.recommended_action: Look for a marketing or partner-sharing setting and decline it if you do not want it; ask QuickBasket how to opt out.

findings.title: Vague purposes
findings.explanation: 'Improve our services' and 'other business purposes' could cover almost anything, so you cannot tell what your data will be used for.

quotes.quote: improve our services and for other business purposes

findings.recommended_action: Ask QuickBasket to list the specific purposes for each type of data.

findings.title: Open-ended retention
findings.explanation: Data is kept as long as the company 'considers necessary', with no period or criteria.

quotes.quote: We keep your information for as long as we consider necessary.

findings.recommended_action: Ask how long location, contacts and account data are kept and when they are deleted.

findings.title: Agreement inferred from continued use
findings.explanation: The notice treats using the app as agreement, instead of describing a clear choice by you.

quotes.quote: By continuing to use the app you agree to this notice.

findings.recommended_action: Ask whether there are separate, explicit choices for optional uses such as marketing.

findings.title: No withdrawal route described
findings.explanation: The complete notice does not explain how to withdraw consent or turn off permissions or sharing.
missing_context: App settings may offer a route that the notice does not mention
findings.recommended_action: Check your phone's app-permission settings and the app's account settings; ask QuickBasket for the withdrawal process.

targeted_questions.question: Does the app work for ordering if I deny contacts and microphone access?
targeted_questions.why_it_matters: Shows whether these permissions are truly needed for delivery.

targeted_questions.question: Why do you need my location when the app is closed?
targeted_questions.why_it_matters: Background location reveals your movements all day, not just your delivery address.

targeted_questions.question: Which partners receive my data for marketing, and how do I opt out?
targeted_questions.why_it_matters: Unnamed recipients and no opt-out mean you cannot control onward use.

targeted_questions.question: How long do you keep my location history and contacts?
targeted_questions.why_it_matters: Open-ended retention increases exposure over time.

next_steps.action: If your phone offers it, set location to 'while using the app' and deny contacts and microphone, then check whether ordering still works.
Ask QuickBasket support the questions above before agreeing.
Consider an alternative service if mandatory access remains unexplained.
